title: Design System: Physical Panorama COSMIC Applet

title.purpose: Panorama title and loading title; configured interface font.

caption.purpose: Collection/count, mode and busy guidance; configured interface font.

button-label.purpose: Transport and retry actions; configured interface font.

nativePlatform.themeAuthority: Runtime COSMIC background, on-background, divider, button and accent focus roles; configured interface font and corner radii.
nativePlatform.previewLimit: Native Rust/iced components have no faithful standalone HTML/CSS implementation; web previews and synthesized tonal ramps are omitted.
nativePlatform.verification: Headless 2x light/dark content fixtures: normal, busy-long-title, error, empty, loading. Installed upper-panel process and icon verified live. Popup opening, keyboard/focus interactions and separate Wayland dropdown surfaces unverified: mixed-scale input cannot reliably target layer-shell surfaces.

components.name: Transport and Retry
components.description: Native widget::button::standard with theme hover/focus/disabled states; transport includes symbolic leading icons.

components.name: Collection and Interval
components.description: Native widget::dropdown::popup_dropdown inside settings items; collection counts and selected configured interval remain visible.

components.name: Panel Popup
components.description: Native applet icon_button and popup_container; status stack precedes transport, settings and contextual feedback.

narrative.overview: A native COSMIC panel control for physical-panorama. Compact status and controls follow the installed desktop theme and interface font; this applet adds no independent brand palette or display face.
keyCharacteristics: Status first, transport second, configuration below.
Explicit busy, empty, loading and retry states.

rules.name: The Native Authority Rule
rules.body: Theme roles stay live; screenshot colors are evidence of a fixture, not fixed app tokens.

dos: Do retain native hover, focus and disabled states.
Do keep group and interval choices independent when queued.
Do preserve action errors across automatic status refreshes until retry or another action.
donts: Don't freeze theme colors, fonts or corner radii into app-specific replacements.
Don't treat headless fixtures as proof of live panel or dropdown-surface integration.
